blockingFinding.title: Snapshot failure replaces current live text with old body; Retry/Remove commits the old body and clears retained recovery.
blockingFinding.observed: Original SnapshotFailureKeepsCurrentText fails; four viewport/locale copies and four keyboard Retry cases reproduce. Current text remains in raw export before retry/remove, but disappears from rendered and saved body afterward.
blockingFinding.sourceCause: Source-supported causal explanation: BodyEditor stores raw invalid live JSON in recoveryBody onSnapshotError. parseStoredDocument(recoveryValue) fails, so its controlled document falls back to the previously saved value. RichTextEditor reapplies that initial document through setContent. RetrySnapshot/removeImages operate on that old live document; parent onChange clears recoveryBody and saved status resumes.

secondaryObservations: Keyboard Retry receives focus and activates, then focus falls to BODY when its controls disappear in all four failed snapshot cases. Recorded DOM focus is retained in failed-case-browser-records.json.
The en1440 edit/reselect case reaches restoration assertion with one missing character; the test has no pre-reopen body assertion, so attribution to entry or persistence remains unresolved.
Original SlashMenu displays heading choices in PNG but role option lookup fails. No fallback to weaker assertion or unrelated source fix was made.
